title: Bedrock Deepslatified
description: Makes bedrock match deepslate for a cleaner, more consistent underground aesthetic.
body:
# Bedrock Deepslatified

Replaces bedrock with a darker deepslate texture for a cleaner, more consistent underground aesthetic.

## Requirements:
- Minecraft 1.17+
